app.name: Supplier Carbon
app.tagline: Forward the email. Photograph the bills. Get back the completed questionnaire.
app.sharedNotice: {year} is shared. Bills, questions and the inventory here also serve: {names}.

signIn.eyebrow: For suppliers asked for carbon data

points.p1: Your bills stay yours: only you can read your account.
points.p2: Works on a phone camera; no scanner or spreadsheet needed.
points.p3: Available in Vietnamese, Japanese and English.

signIn.title: Sign in with your email.
signIn.lede: We email you a sign-in link. No password, no account to create, nothing else stored about you.
signIn.linkSentTo: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device.
signIn.linkNote: The link works once and expires after an hour.
signIn.confirmBody: You opened the link on a different device. Enter the address it was sent to.
signIn.error: That did not work. Check the address and try again.
signIn.invalidEmail: That email address doesn't look right.
signIn.linkExpired: This link has expired or was already used. Send a new one.
signIn.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
signIn.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
signIn.devHint: Local emulator: any email works and the link is printed in the emulator log.
signIn.unavailable: Sign-in isn't available on this address yet. Use the main address of the site, or try again later.
signIn.spamTitle: Check your spam or junk folder
signIn.spamHint: It can take a minute. The email comes from {sender}. If it is in spam, mark it “not spam” so the next link arrives in your inbox.

setup.title: About your company
setup.lede: Three things decide how your figures are calculated: where you are, which year your customer asked for, and which sites count.
setup.name: Company name
setup.startOverLede: Delete every bill, answer and result for this account. Your company details stay.
setup.startOverConfirm: Delete all bills, answers and results? Your company details will be kept.
setup.sitesHint: One row per factory or office whose bills you will upload. A street address, for solar estimates, is asked later on the Reduce page.
setup.startedOver: All bills, answers and results removed.
setup.countryHint: Sets the electricity emission factor and the price checks on your bills.

documents.title: Your bills
documents.lede: Electricity bills, fuel invoices, LPG deliveries, refrigerant service slips. Photos or PDFs, any order, any language.
documents.dropBody: Photos or PDFs. You can review the list before anything is uploaded.
documents.onlyImagesPdf: Only images and PDFs can be read. Other files were skipped.
documents.uploadingHint: Each bill is read by the model as it arrives. Keep this page open.
documents.emptyBody: Start with an electricity bill. Any language, any order; we sort them out.
documents.emptyHint: The model found no energy quantity in this file. Is it a bill?
documents.removeBody: {name} and the data read from it will be deleted. Your figures will be recalculated the next time you check your bills.
documents.summaryFoot: Solid = read from a bill. Dashed = no bill covers that month yet; we will ask about it on the next step. Diesel and refrigerant are deliveries, not monthly bills, so they have no strip.
documents.needMore: Add at least one bill to continue.
documents.removeShared: This year is shared with {names}: their figures change too.

reconcile.title: A few questions
reconcile.lede: We compared your bills against the reporting year. Anything missing or unclear, we ask you here.
reconcile.resetConfirm: Clear the conversation, your answers and the calculated figures? Your bills are kept, so you can answer differently.
reconcile.resetDone: Questions reset. Your bills are kept.
reconcile.startHint: We compare the bills against your reporting year, drop duplicates, cut periods to the year and look for months with nothing. Anything the checks cannot settle, we ask you.
reconcile.startNoDocs: Upload at least one bill first.
reconcile.systemCard: Checked {docs} bill(s) · {n} thing(s) to ask you

note.apportioned: {n} bill(s) straddling the year apportioned by days
note.outsideFy: {n} record(s) outside the reporting year ignored

issue.unitHours: {energy} recorded in running hours; litres per hour needed
issue.lowConfidence: A {energy} value was hard to read; please confirm
issue.indexMismatch: A {energy} bill: the meter readings do not add up to its total; please check
issue.priceImplausible: A {energy} bill: the price per unit looks off; please check
issue.outlier: A {energy} month is far from your usual pattern; please check

reconcile.resetShared: This year is shared with {names}: their figures will be recalculated too.

inventory.title: Your inventory
inventory.lede: Every number traces back to a bill, a published emission factor and, where you told us something, the assumption we recorded.
inventory.notComputedBody: Finish the questions first, or calculate now from the bills as they are.

tierWhy.primary: Quantity read from an invoice or meter reading
tierWhy.secondary: Corrected by you or converted from another unit
tierWhy.estimated: Filled from your answer to a question

factorCard.nearestYear: The {year} factor is the nearest published vintage for your reporting year.
factorCard.nationalFallback: National factor used; no sub-national factor exists for this site.
factorCard.marketFallback: No residual-mix or contract factor is published here, so the market-based figure uses the grid average (GHG Protocol Scope 2 hierarchy).

method.title: How these figures were calculated
method.lede: {n} published factor(s), {a} assumption(s). Tap to read the method.
method.scope2Value: Reported both location-based (headline) and market-based, per the Scope 2 Guidance dual-reporting requirement.

inventory.noAssumptions: No assumptions touch this line. It is a straight read from the bill.
inventory.correctBody: {from} {unit} becomes {to} {unit}. The line is marked as corrected by you and every total is recalculated.

questionnaire.title: Your customer's questionnaire
questionnaire.lede: Upload the Excel your customer sent. We fill every cell we can from your inventory and flag the rest.
questionnaire.share: Share of your output this customer buys (optional, for allocation)
questionnaire.lockedHint: From your bills — correct the quantity in the inventory
questionnaire.dropBody: Drop the .xlsx here or choose it. We keep the layout and write into the answer column.
questionnaire.legend: Green cells come from your bills and the calculator. Blue cells you typed. Yellow cells are for you to complete; the reason is written beside them.
questionnaire.emptyBody: Upload the Excel your customer sent. Try data/templates/cdp_sme_questionnaire.xlsx for the CDP SME climate module.
questionnaire.attachedTemplate: Attached to this request: {name}. Fill it, or choose a different file.
questionnaire.noBills: No bill is behind this number.

landing.eyebrow: For suppliers asked for carbon data
landing.sub: Your customer sent an emissions questionnaire. Upload your electricity, fuel and refrigerant bills; we read them, ask only what the bills cannot tell us, and hand back a Scope 1 and 2 inventory with every number traced to a document and a published factor.

bills.title: Bills
bills.body: Photograph or upload electricity bills, fuel invoices, LPG deliveries and refrigerant slips. Any language, any order.

questions.title: Questions
questions.body: We drop duplicates, cut periods to your reporting year and find the months with nothing. Then we ask you, one question at a time.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.body: Scope 1 and 2 by month, site and fuel. Every line opens into the bill, the factor with its source, and the arithmetic.

questionnaire.title: Questionnaire
questionnaire.body: Upload your customer's Excel. We fill what the inventory can answer, flag what only you can, and give you the file back.

landing.finalTitle: Your bills already hold the answer.
landing.finalBody: Sign in with your email and upload the first one.
landing.footerNote: Demo build. Bills shown are synthetic; emission factors are real and cited.

demo.aria: Animated product demo: bills are uploaded and read, a missing LPG quarter is filled after a question, Scope 1 and Scope 2 totals count up with a traceable calculation, and the customer questionnaire is filled for download.
demo.dropSub: Photos, PDFs or spreadsheets, in any language
demo.ask: No LPG bills for Jul–Sep. Did the canteen run as usual those months?

globe.aria: A 3D earth slowly turning, with green continents on a pale ocean. A factory on it sends up smoke, a truck drives over it and a plane circles it, all leaving puffs of emissions, while tags beside it tally CO₂, N₂O and CH₄ with numbers that rise and fall.

factors.label: published factor sources, each one cited

ai.label: numbers written by the AI; code does the maths

landing.scrollCue: Scroll to see how it works

story.title: Every tonne, traced back to a bill.

flow.aria: Supplier Carbon at work: bills are uploaded and read, a bill is scanned and a missing month is asked about, the Scope 1 and 2 inventory builds, and the customer's questionnaire is filled.

upload.dropSub: Photos, PDFs or spreadsheets, any language

scan.ask: Was the Biên Hòa plant shut in March?

inv.trace: Jan · 42,569 kWh × 0.659 kg/kWh = 28.1 tCO₂e · from the EVN bill

reads.title: Reads any bill
reads.body: Photos, PDFs or spreadsheets, in any language.

checks.title: Checks every bill
checks.body: Meter maths, price bands and odd months, caught before they count.

asks.title: Asks only what's missing
asks.body: One question at a time, in your language.

evidence.title: Shows you where
evidence.body: Every number links to the spot on the bill it came from.

outputs.title: Fills your buyer's Excel
outputs.body: Answers in their own sheet, each one cited.

advisor.title: Plans the cuts
advisor.body: Rooftop solar sized to your use, with the payback.

factors.title: Published factors, cited
factors.body: National grid factors, IPCC and DEFRA values, each with its source, vintage and link.

lineage.title: Every number has a trail
lineage.body: Document → quantity → factor → result. Rendered on screen and in the methodology PDF.

honest.title: Honest about gaps
honest.body: Cells we cannot answer are flagged for you, never guessed. Estimated months are marked as such.

outputs.title: Files your buyer accepts
outputs.body: The filled workbook, colour-coded by source, and an auditor-readable methodology note.

footer.blurb: Photograph the bills. Get the questionnaire back, with every number traced to a document and a published factor.

stepLock.reconcile: Unlocks once at least one bill has been read
stepLock.inventory: Unlocks once the questions are answered
stepLock.questionnaire: Unlocks once the inventory is calculated

home.greeting: {n, plural, =0 {No requests yet} =1 {One request} other {# requests}}
home.ledeSome: Each card is a customer who asked for your numbers. Bills and figures belong to the reporting year and are shared between requests for the same year.
home.ledeNone: Start with the customer who asked. Bills and figures are collected per reporting year and reused for every request on that year.
home.noYears: No reporting year yet. It is created with your first request.
home.emptyBody: Name the customer and the year they asked about. You can attach their Excel now or later.
home.deleteBody: {name} and its filled questionnaire will be removed. The bills and inventory for {year} stay, since other requests may use them.

new.title: New request
new.lede: Who asked, and for which year.
new.yearHint: Bills and figures already on this year are reused.
new.share: Share of your output they buy, % (optional)
new.templateOptional: You can also attach it at the last step.

home.yearDeleteBody: {year}, its {n} bill(s) and its inventory will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
home.yearDeleteBodyUsed: {year}, its {n} bill(s) and its inventory will be deleted for good, together with the request(s) from {names} and their questionnaires. This cannot be undone.

evidence.title: Where this number comes from
evidence.hint: The spotlight marks the figure printed on your bill.
evidence.noBox: We did not record where this value sits on the page, so the whole bill is shown.
evidence.loadError: The bill could not be displayed.

index.fail: Meter readings do not add up

price.confirmed: Price looked off, confirmed by you

reduce.title: Where you could cut emissions
reduce.lede: Rooftop solar sized to what your site actually uses, and the other changes that would move your numbers most. Estimates, with sources.
reduce.needInventoryBody: Ideas for cutting emissions are based on your own figures, so they appear once the inventory is calculated.

locate.title: Where is this site?
locate.hint: Start typing the building's address and pick it from the list. Suggestions only show places in {country}, the country you chose for this site. Include the lot number in an industrial park. Or paste the coordinates of your roof from Google Maps (right-click the roof, then click the numbers). We use this only to measure your roof for solar.
locate.placeholder: Start typing: Lot B2, Long Hau Industrial Park, or paste 10.7290, 106.7190
locate.approximate: We only matched the street or area, so the roof found may not be yours. Add the building number, or paste the coordinates of your roof.
locate.suggestionCount: {n, plural, one {# suggestion} other {# suggestions}} available. Use the arrow keys and Enter to choose.

solar.title: Rooftop solar
solar.error: The roof lookup did not work just now: {msg}
solar.headline: Solar could cover about {pct}% of your electricity and avoid about {t} tCO2e a year.
solar.payback: It would pay back in about {years} years.
solar.estimated: Estimate from sunshine data and the roof area you gave
solar.roofHint: Google has no roof imagery for this location, so we use sunshine data. Tell us the roof area you could use and we will estimate.
solar.unavailable: No rooftop estimate for this site yet.

levers.title: Other ways to cut
levers.worse: Would add about {n} tCO2e a year on your electricity grid

scenario.title: If you did these
scenario.saves: Saves about {t} tCO2e a year, {pct}% of your Scope 1 and 2.
scenario.market: Certificates would lower market-based Scope 2 by about {t} tCO2e more.

reduce.disclaimer: These are estimates to help you decide, not commitments. Get a quote before you invest.

card.title: Where you could cut emissions
card.body: Rooftop solar sized to your own use, plus the changes that would move your numbers most.
